name: @absolutejs/devices
description: Provider-neutral device capability contracts and web, SSR, and test adapters for AbsoluteJS
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && bun build src/runtime.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && bun build src/ssr.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && bun build src/testing.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && bun build src/web.ts --outdir dist --target=browser && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
